name: earshot
description: Screen reader companion for Claude Code: detects VoiceOver, NVDA or JAWS, enables screen reader mode from the next start, delivers whole answers, narrates tool activity, and adds the /earshot-on, /earshot-off, /earshot-status, /earshot-stream, /earshot-last, /earshot-tools, /earshot-heartbeat and /earshot-log commands.
displayName: Earshot: screen reader companion for Claude Code
